name: devdeck
description: DevDeck — a personal, local-first workspace and API layer for developers.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:preview: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web -- --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
